credits.title: Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift
credits.overview: It's the holiday season in Fraggle Rock, and Wembley can't wait to spread cheer as the Spirit Captain. But when the festive spirit starts fading, Wembley sets out to discover what truly makes the season special.

credits.title: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock
credits.overview: When the holidays are filled with unexpected adventures and challenges, the Fraggles learn to appreciate each day for being unique and special, like a snowflake.

credits.title: Sid the Science Kid: The Movie
credits.overview: In Sid's very first film debut, Sid and his classmate Gabriela enter a contest and win the exclusive opportunity to visit a new modern science museum before it opens to the public.

credits.title: Extreme Movie
credits.overview: A sketch comedy movie about the joys and embarrassments of teen sex. But mostly the embarrassments.

credits.title: Catch Me If You Can
credits.overview: A true story about Frank Abagnale Jr. who, before his 19th birthday, successfully conned millions of dollars worth of checks as a Pan Am pilot, doctor, and legal prosecutor. An FBI agent makes it his mission to put him behind bars. But Frank not only eludes capture, he revels in the pursuit.

credits.title: Solaris
credits.overview: A troubled psychologist is sent to investigate the crew of an isolated research station orbiting a bizarre planet.

credits.title: Patch Adams
credits.overview: The true story of Dr. Hunter "Patch" Adams, who in the 1970s found that humor is the best medicine, and was willing to do just anything to make his patients laugh—even if it meant risking his own career.

credits.title: Shame II: The Secret
credits.overview: A motorcycle riding lawyer fights to save the life of a mentally retarded man on death row. His own mother is ready to let him go.
